readings: For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), give the average `spent` and the average `remaining` across its budget lines. Also give how much its average remaining exceeds the mean of all the per-event average remaining values (each event counted once), as average remaining minus that mean. Ignore missing values in the averages. Sort by that difference, highest first, with missing values last, and show the top 10. Don't round.
queries:
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
           AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_spent,
       avg_remaining,
       avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff
FROM per_event
ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
